name: previbe
description: Validate SaaS and product ideas with PreVibe market research, deep dives, brand names, and domain availability.

interface.longDescription:
PreVibe turns a raw product idea into a market research report you can act on.

Describe your idea in plain language. PreVibe runs live web research and returns a verdict badge, a score, a short summary, the key findings, and the three strongest bets - the angles most likely to work, and why now. Key figures come with clickable sources, or are marked honestly when no source exists. You also get the main reasons the idea could fail, and what would change the answer.

From a finished report you can go further:

- Deep dives expand the idea, or any top bet, into positioning, MVP scope, and a go-to-market angle.
- Brand names generate name ideas grounded in your research, then check domain availability through a registrar.

The plugin's tools cover the whole workflow. Some only read data you already own: list and fetch researches, deep dives, and brand-name runs. Others create, retry, or delete. Every tool declares what it does through standard MCP annotations, so you can see which ones only read and which ones change something before you approve.

Who it is for: solo founders and small teams who want evidence before committing weeks of build time.

Before you connect: a PreVibe account, created with Google or email sign-in.

Your ideas stay yours. We configure our AI providers for zero data retention where that option is available.
